# Same Day Express Couriers

> UK same-day dedicated courier service. Nationwide collection within 60 minutes. DBS-vetted drivers, £20,000 goods-in-transit insurance, signed proof of delivery, 24/7 dispatch. Direct delivery — no hubs, no multi-drop.

Pricing: motorcycle from £25 base + £1.00/mile; vans and Lutons up to £75 base + £2.10/mile. Instant online quote at https://samedayexpresscouriers.co.uk/#quote.

## Services

- [Same Day Courier](https://samedayexpresscouriers.co.uk/same-day-courier): Nationwide dedicated-vehicle delivery, collect in 60 minutes.
- [AOG & Aviation Courier](https://samedayexpresscouriers.co.uk/aog-aviation-courier): Aircraft-on-ground emergency parts delivery to all major UK airports.
- [Medical Courier](https://samedayexpresscouriers.co.uk/services/medical-courier): Specimen, pharmaceutical, and NHS transport with cold-chain handling.
- [Legal Document Courier](https://samedayexpresscouriers.co.uk/services/legal-courier): Court filings, contracts, and confidential document hand-delivery.

## Fleet

Motorcycle (20kg), small van (400kg), Transit SWB/LWB, Trafic MWB, Sprinter XLWB, Luton Box (1,200kg), Luton Curtain. Details: https://samedayexpresscouriers.co.uk/fleet.
